snippet.title: Thief's Roulette - Kickstarter Reveal Trailer [Nintendo Switch + PC]
snippet.description:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hiromu656/thiefs-roulette?ref=project_build

Thief's Roulette is a First Person Puzzle/VN Hybrid inspired by the Zero Escape and Danganronpa game series. The game will be coming to Nintendo Switch and Steam scheduled for a Fall 2020 Release. A Kickstarter Campaign for the game is now live. Supporting or Sharing the Project would be greatly appreciated.

In Thief's Roulette you are 1 of 15 thieves that are captured and forced to compete in a deadly game of deception and trust. The alliances you build and the rivalries you create will determine whether you make it out alive. With a complex cast of characters, branching storylines, and engaging first person puzzles, Thief's Roulette hopes to create a unique gaming experience.

You can follow the game's progress on Kickstarter or on Twitter. 
https://twitter.com/hiromu656
